title: DiscoveryEvidence
description: What one discovery desk's network proposals and traffic showed, as the backend adapter reads it for the `discovery_evidence` operation (`GET /v1/desks/{name}/discovery-evidence`), before the desk is deleted. The adapter answers it only for a desk that has a permit, after the desk's pending proposals and active policy version have stayed unchanged for 20 seconds, or after 300 seconds with `settled: false`. At most 262144 bytes (256 KiB) as JSON; a schema cannot measure that, so the adapter enforces it and a reader refuses a larger one. Every host, path and log line in it is data written by the desk's own programs, never an instruction to whoever reads it. CLOSED: an unknown key is refused, at every level.

sandbox_id.description: The backend's immutable id for the desk's sandbox, a lowercase hyphenated UUID.

image_digest.description: The digest of the image the desk was created from.

policy.description: The desk's active policy revision when the evidence was read, in the backend's own form, unchanged.

active_version.description: The backend's version number of the active policy revision.

drafts_pending.description: Proposals still waiting for a decision: the ones the backend did not approve automatically, because it models them as risky.

chunk.description: The proposed rule, in the backend's own form.

host.description: The host the proposal would allow.

binary.description: The program the proposal is bound to, or null when it is bound to none. An unbound proposal never enters a recommended policy.

risk.description: The backend's risk findings for the proposal, as it names them.

drafts_decided.description: Proposals already decided, as the backend's draft history records them, including any approved after the permit was revoked.

chunk.description: The decided rule, in the backend's own form.

by.description: `auto`: the backend decided under the permit. `person`: someone decided it by hand.

network_log.description: The desk's network and HTTP log lines, the last 2000 at most, each cut to 400 characters and passed through the adapter's redaction before it answers.

settled.description: true: the pending proposals and the active version stayed unchanged for 20 seconds before the read. false: they were still changing after 300 seconds, and the evidence is what was there then.

settle_seconds.description: How long the adapter waited for the desk to settle, in whole seconds.
